newsitem.title: NORWAY: SAS mulls disposal of Radisson hotel chain.
newsitem.headline: SAS mulls disposal of Radisson hotel chain.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System said Monday it was reviewing various options for its Radisson hotel business and had engaged an international investment bank to help in the evaluation.
"In its long-term strategy to focus on its core business SAS constantly reviews various options for businesses within the group," SAS said in a statement to the Oslo Stock Market.
"The hotel business is currently subject to such a review," it added.
SAS said it issued the statement following recent media speculation concerning a possible disposal of its hotel operations.
It added that no decision had been made.
